raw_text: Press Release — Indian Army PRO (Tezpur), June 13, 2024. The Indian Army is aware of certain video clips and images circulating on social media purporting to show recent Chinese military activity in the Doklam area. After thorough verification, the Indian Army confirms that no unusual Chinese military activity has been observed in the Doklam tri-junction area. The situation along the Line of Actual Contact in the Sikkim sector remains stable and under continuous surveillance. The footage in circulation appears to be dated material. The Indian Army urges the public and media not to share unverified content that may cause unnecessary alarm.
